We’re the people
you want in the room.

Think is a team of strategists, designers, and engineers who partner with people navigating real complexity — to work through the hard stuff, find what needs solving, and build what works.

Ask us anything...
What kind of work does Think do?
How does Think approach AI?
Show me work relevant to my industry...
How is Think different than a typical agency?
Ask us anything

FEATURED WORK

We solve the problems
worth solving.

We don’t start with the interface. We start with the people using it — their context, their constraints, what’s working against them and why.

Global Media & Tech Company

Telecom/Utilities

This company’s support teams hunted for answers across a dozen tools. Now one platform brings the answers to them.

Merck

Pharmaceuticals

Merck’s information can save lives, but only if the right people can find it. Think made sure they could.

Global Shipping and Logistics Operator

Shipping & Logistics

One of the largest logistics operators moving vehicles and heavy equipment by sea ran on paper and spreadsheets. Its terminals and processing centers spoke different languages. We gave them one.
Show me work in my industry...
See more work

HOW WE HELP

You’re navigating
something complex.
We’ve been here before. The challenges usually look something like this.
“Everything is a priority. Our backlog has three hundred items and nobody can tell you which ten matter.”
We start with people, find the real problem, and make a plan to solve it.
Research & Product Strategy
“Our software is outdated. Our users are suffering for it, and some of them are starting to choose competitors.”
We modernize the digital products that are holding your business back.
Product Design & Build
“We’ve tried staffing firms. We get junior people and spend half our time managing them.”
We embed with your team and operate like insiders.
Embedded Teams & Staffing
“Leadership wants everyone using AI. Nobody’s trained on how to use it well.”
We help you cut through the AI noise, focus on what matters, and get it built.
AI Strategy, Design & Build
“Design and engineering are always out of sync. AI tools are making it worse.”
We build the foundation your designers, engineers, and AI tools can all work from.
Design Systems & AI Enablement
